description: This grouped bar chart, presented at a tilted angle, illustrates the performance gain for different models under two supervision conditions. The horizontal category axis displays the models, featuring visible labels for "Claude-3.5-Sonnet" and a partially obscured "Qwen2-72B-V...", alongside a third category on the far left whose label is cut off from the image frame. The vertical value axis is labeled "Performance Gain (++%)" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 5 to 30 at regular intervals of 5 units. The bars are grouped by model category, with each group containing two side-by-side bars representing different supervision types, as indicated by a legend at the top. The "Strong Supervision" component is represented by a blue bar with white diagonal hatching, while the "Weak Supervision" component is represented by a solid light blue bar. Across all visible groups, the hatched Strong Supervision bars are taller than their solid Weak Supervision counterparts. For the leftmost unlabeled category, the Strong Supervision bar reaches approximately 25, while the Weak Supervision bar is the shortest on the chart at roughly 7. For "Claude-3.5-Sonnet", the Strong Supervision bar is near 14 and the Weak Supervision bar is near 9. For the rightmost category, "Qwen2-72B-V...", the Strong Supervision bar is approximately 23, and the Weak Supervision bar is about 14. The categories do not appear to be sorted in a specific ascending or descending order, and the Strong Supervision bars are visually emphasized through their hatched pattern.
